standard.summary: 异步预取后续 FLUX.1 block 的个数，需开启 Pin Memory 才有效；默认 1。
standard.whenToUse: 仅在 FLUX Transformer Offload 为 block_residency 时生效；开启 Pin Memory 后保持默认 1。
standard.avoidWhen: 未开启 Pin Memory 时预取无法与计算重叠，调大没有收益。

standard_en.summary: How many upcoming FLUX.1 blocks are prefetched asynchronously; only effective with Pin Memory on. Default 1.
standard_en.whenToUse: Only applies when FLUX Transformer Offload is block_residency; keep the default of 1 once Pin Memory is on.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Without Pin Memory the prefetch cannot overlap compute, so raising it gains nothing.

advanced.principle: 预取在独立传输流上把下一个 block 的权重搬进显存。只有锁页内存的拷贝能与计算并行；普通内存的拷贝会卡住 CPU。
advanced.tradeoffs: 预取深度受 GPU 槽位数限制，深度大于槽位数减一时多出的部分不会生效。

advanced_en.principle: Prefetch copies the next block's weights to VRAM on a separate transfer stream. Only copies from pinned memory run alongside compute; pageable copies block the CPU.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Depth is capped by the GPU slot count; depth beyond slots minus one has no effect.
